messages:
maria: heads-up — nightly CI shows a 2.2x p50/p95 spike for small-sequence paths after the driver bump to CUDA 12.11.1. Appears during KV-prefetch/evict phase across multi-GPU shards :eyes:

sam: can you paste the minimal repro and profiler output?

maria: reproducer and perf snippet below — run with the smallseq job in ci: `python -m bench.smallseq --seq 8 --batch 1 --profile`

```
# perf summary (before -> after)
p50: 18.7ms -> 41.1ms
p95: 34.2ms -> 92.8ms
hot funcs: triton_kv_prefetch, triton_attn_cu, cudaMemcpyAsync
notes: extra memcpy spikes align with KV-evict window and cross-GPU transfers
```

liu: seeing similar on my workstation. My hw traces show prefetch work enqueued to copy engine but stream affinity changed so copies interleave with compute leading to cache thrash. Might be memcpy scheduler heuristic in 12.11.1.

bench-bot: automated profile uploaded to artifacts: https://ci.internal/abcd1234/artifacts/kv-prefetch-profile.zip

ashley: @sam this is blocking the rollout of the driver/triton combo — infra marked as blocker. Can you bisect driver vs triton?

sam: starting bisect: testing combinations: CUDA 12.11.0 vs 12.11.1, Triton 2.6.1 vs 2.6.3. Running the smallseq perf job across 3 seeds.

infra-ci: nightly job failed: 'smallseq-prefetch-regression' threshold exceeded. Job auto-tagged: rollout-blocker.

maria: quick mitigation idea: force prefetch to use dedicated stream and serialize evict calls. We can expose env hint `REDWOOD_KV_PREFETCH_SINGLE_STREAM=1` to gate this in CI/images. Example: `export REDWOOD_KV_PREFETCH_SINGLE_STREAM=1`

liu: repro script to toggle the hint below:

```bash
export REDWOOD_KV_PREFETCH_SINGLE_STREAM=1
python -m bench.smallseq --seq 8 --batch 1 --profile
```

sam: bisect update: narrowed root cause to the driver 12.11.1 memcpy scheduler tweak. With 12.11.0 + Triton 2.6.3 perf is stable; swapping to 12.11.1 flips kernel dispatch ordering and increases memcpy latency during prefetch windows.

maria: that matches traces — prefetch races with eviction and causes unnecessary memcpy round-trips (stale KV pages get re-transferred).

ashley: decision: pin CUDA driver to 12.11.0 in CI images and in Dedicated images while we investigate. Marking rollout blocked until pinned. I'll open a PR to pin in infra images and add a regression test.

bench-bot: opened regression test: `smallseq-prefetch-regtest` (job id: 5566). Link: https://ci.internal/jobs/5566

sam: filing upstream with vendor — attaching perf traces and timeline (kernel names + timestamps). Issue #4487 created.

liu: follow-up work: add affinity hint to kernel selector so prefetch uses a fenced stream on multi-gpu, and add KV cache eviction TTL jitter to avoid synchronized evict spikes.

maria: good. Also add an integration test that runs smallseq on multi-gpu short window to catch this.

ashley: created infra PR to pin driver and to add the regtest to nightly. Moving this to incidents for tracking: /incidents/kv-prefetch-driver-regression-2172

sam: I'll run a live repro on dedicated repro machines and try a micropatch in runtime to force prefetch serialization. If that makes perf stable we can ship a small runtime patch while vendors look at driver.

maria: thanks — keeping this thread updated. tagging @eng-runtime-perf for follow-up. :thumbsup:
